title: Creative Operations Manager - E-commerce
description:
Want to run a creative department end to end? Join us as our Creative Operations Manager and take full ownership of the team, the dashboard, and the output of a fast-growing e-commerce brand.



We’re a fast-growing e-commerce company hiring a Creative Operations Manager to run our creative department, including video editors, graphic designers, and copywriters.



You are not here to make the creative. You are here to make the creative machine run: capacity, output, deadlines, systems, and people.



This is a leadership role. You will be trusted to own outcomes, not micromanaged on tasks. If you prefer a task-only execution role, this is not for you.



This role lives in the numbers. You’ll own our creative dashboard entirely, and at any 
nt, you’ll know who has room for more work, who is overloaded, and what is at risk of slipping before anyone asks.



You don’t manage from a distance. You catch problems early, confront underperformance directly, and make difficult people decisions with confidence.



Full ownership is the goal. This role is measured by one thing: how efficiently you scale creative output without sacrificing quality.



What You’ll Own



The Dashboard and Capacity Planning



* Own the creative operations dashboard, including capacity, utilization, deadlines, and workload.

* Track output per editor and per project. Spot bottlenecks before they affect production.

* Forecast production and hiring needs weekly and monthly.

* Bring leadership data-backed recommendations, not opinions.

* When a number drops, find the leak and put a fix in place.



The Team



* Directly manage the video editing team, with copywriters and other creative tea
mbers in scope when needed.

* Run interviews and assess talent effectively. Hiring is a core part of this role.

* Run one-on-ones and performance reviews.

* Hold people accountable. When someone underperforms, identify the problem, set a clear improvement plan with a deadline, and make the final call if they do not meet expectations.



Process, Systems, and AI



* Audit and rebuild outdated workflows and SOPs across the creative pipeline.

* Ensure every project has an owner, a deadline, and a clear status.

* Use AI daily to multiply output through SOP creation, data analysis, automation, reporting, and forecasting.

* Grow production capacity without automatically growing headcount.

* Work confidently with spreadsheets and automation tools.

* Keep individual contributors, managers, and leadership aligned so production never stops.



Before You Apply



We want to be transparent and respectful of everyone’s time.



This is a senior management position, not an assistant, coordinator, specialist, or first-time leadership role. To be considered, you must have at least three years of direct experience in both e-commerce and operations management, including experience working specifically as an Operations Manager or in a genuinely equivalent management position.



Experience as an assistant, team lead, project coordinator, or individual contributor will not meet the requirements for this role unless you also have the required Operations Manager experience.



Applications that do not clearly demonstrate at least three years of relevant e-commerce operations management experience will be automatically disqualified. Please apply only if your background matches this requirement.



Must-Haves



* At least three years of direct experience as an Operations Manager or in an equivalent management role within e-commerce.

* Experience managing teams, ideally creative, production, or operational teams.

* Highly analytical and obsessed with numbers. Capacity planning, utilization, and performance metrics are your comfort zone.

* A direct communicator who does not avoid conflict. You address problems head-on and do not let issues sit.

* Comfortable making difficult people decisions, including terminations, with proven experience doing so.

* Proven experience running structured interviews and making hiring decisions.

* Strong data skills. You are highly capable with spreadsheets and understand when to use a median instead of an average.

* Technical enough to work with automation tools, scripts, and developers, and able to learn new software quickly.

* Heavy, hands-on use of AI in daily operations work. You can clearly explain which tools you use, how you use them, and why.

* Extremely organized and process-oriented. Nothing sits, nothing waits, and you always know who is stuck and what is blocking them.

* Strong written and spoken English. You will run meetings, hold people accountable, and write SOPs.

* Daily availability from 1 PM to 10 PM Manila time, GMT+8, with reasonable availability when urgent issues arise.



Nice-to-Haves



* Experience managing video editors, designers, copywriters, or other creative production teams at scale.

* Experience building or owning a capacity, utilization, or KPI dashboard.

* Strong experience with ClickUp, Notion, Airtable, 
, or similar tools.

* Experience building AI workflows or automations.

* A basic understanding of video production workflows. You do not need to edit, but you need to understand what “done” and “good” look like.



Our Hiring Process



We move quickly while respecting your time.



1. Fill out our quick application form. It includes simple questions and takes around five minutes.

2. We respond to every applicant. No ghosting.

3. Qualified applicants complete a short first interview focused on experience and culture fit.

4. Those who pass complete a short technical interview.

5. Crush it, and we send you an offer.



What You’ll Receive After Going Full-Time



Following a successful one-to-two-month probation period, you’ll receive:



* A salary increase above your starting pay

* 13th-month pay

* 18 days of paid time off, plus holidays

* Every AI tool you need, paid for by us

* Health insurance

* An annual training and learning budget

* The opportunity to fly out and meet the rest of the team, completely optional



We genuinely take care of our team and invest heavily in our people. We’re looking for someone who wants to take ownership, grow with us, and build something meaningful for the long term.



One final note before you apply: this is a senior Operations Manager role. You must have at least three years of direct experience in both e-commerce and operations management. Assistant, coordinator, team lead, or individual contributor experience alone will not qualify. Applications that do not clearly meet these requirements will be automatically disqualified.



If your experience matches, we would genuinely love to hear from you.



Apply now. It takes five minutes.

If you are an operator who blindly follows Google's automated recommendations without verifying the underlying data tracking first, this is not the role for you.



We need an expert who treats paid acquisition like a science to scale B2B SaaS and DTC Shopify brands across the US, UK, and European markets.



What You Will Do

Audit and Diagnose: Before touching budgets, you will audit GTM setups, Google Analytics 4 (GA4) event integrity, offline conversion tracking (OCT), and consent mode signals to ensure all optimization is based on 100% clean data.



Execute and Scale: Architect, manage, and scale high-performing Search, Performance Max (PMax), and YouTube or Display campaigns.



Data-First Optimization: Control bid strategies (tCPA, tROAS) mathematically. Proactively identify budget leaks, negative keyword bottlenecks, and low-performing assets early.



AI-First Workflow: Collaborate with our creative team to leverage AI tools for rapid ad copy research, landing page hook testing, and asset variations.



Your Technical Stack and Experience

Minimum of 3 years of proven experience running Google Ads for B2B SaaS or DTC E-commerce brands (Shopify ecosystem preferred).



Deep technical proficiency in Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and server-side tracking configurations.



Expert understanding of structural testing frameworks, data-driven attribution models, and asset group optimization within PMax.



Strong problem-solving attitude with clean, proactive communication skills.



What We Offer

100% Remote work-from-home setup.



Stable, long-term part-time commitment (4 hours a day) with the potential to transition to a full-time role based on performance.



A supportive, AI-first, and data-disciplined agency environment with a clear path for salary growth.

title: Senior Facebook Ads Specialist / Media Buyer (Remote - Full-Time) - Experienced Only
description:
Most people look at a Meta Ads dashboard and only see numbers, CPC, or CTR. We are looking for someone who sees the story behind the data — someone who knows exactly why a creative is wearing out, why a CPA is creeping up, and how to fix it before it impacts the budget.



If you are a data-driven Media Buyer who treats every ad account like your own business, never settles for "good enough," and loves the thrill of scaling winning campaigns, we want you on our team.



We are a fast-growing digital marketing agency. This is a long-term, full-time remote position for a high-level specialist. Please do not apply if you are a beginner or looking for a casual freelance gig.



What You Will Own:

Campaign Management: Plan, set up, launch, and optimize
 & Instagram Ads end-to-end with clean account structures and strict naming conventions.



Testing Framework: Run structured creative and audience testing cycles (using ABO/CBO frameworks) to consistently uncover new hooks and winning combinations.



Data & Tracking: Monitor Meta Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI), and GA4 daily to ensure tracking signals are 100?curate.



Budget Optimization: Manage and scale meaningful daily budgets efficiently, keeping a close eye on ROAS, CPA, and MER.



Creative Collaboration: Analyze ad fatigue, identify winning formats, and collaborate with our creative team to brief new video/image assets based on real performance data.



What You Bring:

Experience: 2 to 4+ years of hands-on media buying experience managing Meta Ads with proven success (be ready to share screenshots/case studies of accounts you’ve personally scaled).



Expert Knowledge: Deep understanding of custom/lookalike audiences, bid strategies (including cost controls), and attribution systems.



Tools: Proficient with Meta Business Suite, Shopify, Google Analytics 4, and structured testing frameworks.



Mindset: A strong problem-solving attitude. You don't wait to be told what to do; you audit the account, find the leak, and propose the solution.



Communication: Excellent written and spoken English. You can explain complex data in a clear, straightforward way.



Work Ethic: Reliable high-speed internet connection, backup power solution, and a dedicated distraction-free workspace.



What’s In It For You:

Salary: Competitive monthly rate based on experience, paid on time via your preferred method.



Growth: Performance-based bonuses tied directly to account scaling and results.



Culture: 100% remote work with a highly supportive, AI-first, and data-driven team.



Stability: Long-term career progression into a Lead Media Buyer or Creative Strategist role.



Schedule: Full-time (40 hours/week), Monday to Friday with flexible hours (requiring a few hours of overlap for team syncs).

We take hiring seriously and only read applications from people who pay attention to detail. Automated or AI-generated spam applications will be filtered out instantly.

, please provide the following details:



Your Updated CV/Resume attached to the

title: Financial Operations Manager / Controller (Commercial Accounting / Full-Cycle / Xero / CPA Preferred)
description:
Job Description



Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Financial Operations Manager

Job Type: Part-Time

Job Hours: Starting at ~15 hours per week, plus additional hours during the monthly close process (typically 15-20 hours in the first 2-weeks of each month).

Job Location:  Remote

Reports to: Financial Controller

Start Date: Early August



About Priority Haulage



Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary



Priority Haulage is seeking a part-time, reliable and capable Financial Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day finance operations and support the monthly close process within a lean, systems-focused environment. This hands-on role is responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, preparing timely management information, and ensuring finance workflows operate efficiently and reliably.



Our finance function is built around well-documented processes, automation, and modern business systems. Routine bookkeeping and operational finance activities are supported by integrated and automated workflows, enabling the successful candidate to focus on financial accuracy, month-end reporting, continuous improvement, and optimising finance processes as the business grows.



Role Overview 



The primary responsibility of this role is the preparation and ownership of Priority Haulage's monthly management accounts and financial close process. Day-to-day financial operations support this objective by ensuring accurate, timely financial information is maintained throughout the month.



This role suits someone who is organised, dependable, systems-minded, and comfortable working autonomously within a structured operational environment. They will be confident using modern business systems and technology to optimise workflows and maintain strong financial controls.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent daily coverage during New Zealand morning business hours, with a structured morning schedule and flexible, outcome-focused afternoon support. Philippine Time (PHT) is typically 4 hours behind NZT (5 hours during NZ daylight saving).



Core Daily Hours (NZT)

9:00 AM – 12:00 PM NZT (5:00 AM – 8:00 AM PHT)

These hours are required each business day and cover core financial operations, daily processing, reconciliations, payroll coordination (Monday only), and communication with the New Zealand team.



The operational finance workload during this period is expected to be manageable within these core hours under normal operating conditions.



Month-End & Management Accounts Cycle

Additional hours are required during the monthly close process.



This includes:



• Close preparation during the final 1–2 business days of the month; and

• Completion of the monthly management accounts package within 8 working days following month-end.



During this period, responsibilities include:



• Reconciliations

• Working papers

• Management accounts preparation

• Review updates

• Close-related coordination



This workload is expected to average approximately 15–20 hours per month depending on the cycle and business activity.



Flexible Support & Process Improvement

Outside core operational and month-end responsibilities, additional flexible hours may be available to support:



• Finance process improvements

• Reporting and documentation enhancements

• Workflow optimisation

• Additional reconciliation and operational finance support as required



These hours will be agreed based on operational priorities and the successful candidate’s capability and availability.



Job Responsibilities



Reporting & Compliance

• Prepare monthly management accounts, reconciliations, and reporting using Xero and CCH Workpapers, ensuring accuracy and timely month-end close. 

• Support GST preparation and adherence to New Zealand accounting standards. 

• Maintain financial data integrity, documentation standards, and contribute to ongoing reporting improvements.



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

• Perform day-to-day bookkeeping activities in Xero.

• Manage the general ledger and maintain the chart of accounts.

• Complete all required financial reconciliations accurately and on time.



Payroll Administration

• Review approved driver timesheets.

• Process weekly payroll, submit payments, and manage IRD filings.

• Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance with New Zealand standards.



Client Management

• Issue client statements and prepare, manage, and communicate job quotations.

• Resolve client account, billing, and payment enquiries.

• Support accounts receivable and debt collection activities via the Client Services Coordinator.



Supplier Management

• Manage supplier accounts, payments, reconciliations, and resolve queries.

• Coordinate subcontractor bills and ensure accurate reconciliation.

• Oversee recurring subscriptions, licensing, registrations, and compliance costs.



Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

• Drive process improvements, system optimisation, and efficiency opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support timely, high-quality workflows

• Partner with leadership to ensure accurate and reliable financial data while contributing to automation initiatives.



Required Experience & Capability



Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating in a structured, deadline-driven finance environment.

• Minimum 7+ years’ hands-on accounting experience.

• Advanced proficiency in Xero is essential.

• Strong Microsoft Excel capability, with proven ability to reconcile and analyse data using XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and financial modelling functions.

• Proven experience preparing monthly management accounts, conducting financial analysis, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities.

• Working knowledge of New Zealand tax regulations, accounting standards, and statutory compliance requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote environment, with strong self-management, reliability, and a consistent track record of meeting deadlines without oversight.

• Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally, supporting finance-related workflows across the business.

• High level of technical proficiency, including the Microsoft platform, with working familiarity in modern business tools.



Preferred Experience 



• CPA qualification required, preferably a Regular Member of PICPA, with a recognised tertiary qualification in accounting.

• Experience within New Zealand or Australian Chartered Accounting firms, including use of CCH Workpapers.

• Exposure to a commercial business environment, ideally within transport, logistics, or fleet-based operations.

•  Experience using Notion, ChatGPT, workflow automation tools, and modern business systems to improve finance operations, documentation, and process efficiency.

• A relevant tertiary qualification in finance, business administration, or a related field.



Personal Attributes



• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to operate autonomously while contributing effectively in a remote team environment.

• Analytical and problem-solving capability, particularly in identifying, investigating, and resolving financial discrepancies.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, client-focused mindset, demonstrating integrity, quality standards, and accountability in delivery.



Required Equipment and Setup



• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer & Internet: Desktop PC or laptop with minimum Intel Core i5 processor, 8GB RAM (16GB preferred), Windows 10/11 compatibility, and a stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps upload/download).

• Monitor Setup: Dual monitors, or a laptop paired with an external monitor.

• Headset: Noise-cancelling headset for clear communication during virtual meetings where operating outside a fully quiet workspace.

• Webcam: High-quality external or integrated camera for video calls.

• Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or generator ensuring at least 3 hours of operational uptime during outages.

• Internet Backup: Secondary internet connection (e.g., mobile data or alternative wireless) for uninterrupted connectivity.



Application Requirement

In your application submission, include the word “Motivated!” in the title.

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
The UX/UI Designer plays a key role in creating intuitive, visually engaging, and conversion-focused digital experiences for e-commerce brands. This role requires a strong understanding of user-centered design, visual interface design, and online customer behavior across desktop and mobile platforms. The ideal candidate is creative, detail-oriented, and experienced in designing seamless shopping experiences that enhance usability, strengthen brand identity, and drive conversions. Experience working with Shopify and other e-commerce platforms is highly valued.



Note: This is a passive sourcing opportunity, and while we are always looking to connect with exceptional talent, it may take some time to find the right match for this role.



Responsibilities:



Design user-friendly and visually compelling interfaces for e-commerce websites, landing pages, and mobile experiences.

Create wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and design systems that align with user needs and business goals.

Optimize key e-commerce touchpoints including homepages, collection pages, product pages, cart flows, and checkout experiences.

Collaborate with developers, marketers, and stakeholders to deliver effective and brand-aligned digital experiences.

Design and improve user journeys for Shopify-based stores and other e-commerce platforms.

Conduct user research, review site behavior, and apply insights to improve usability, engagement, and conversion performance.

Ensure consistency in layout, typography, branding, and interaction design across digital platforms.

Stay up to date with UX/UI trends, Shopify design best practices, and emerging e-commerce experience strategies.

Assist with ongoing design enhancements, testing, and other digital creative tasks as needed.



Requirements:



Proven experience as a UX/UI Designer or in a similar digital design role.

Strong portfolio showcasing web and mobile design projects, preferably for e-commerce or consumer-facing brands.

Solid understanding of UX principles, user flows, wireframing, prototyping, and visual design.

Experience designing for Shopify or other e-commerce platforms.

Knowledge of e-commerce best practices, including product page design, navigation, filtering, cart experience, and mobile optimization.

Proficiency in design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or similar platforms.

Strong attention to detail and ability to balance aesthetics, usability, and conversion goals.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and adapt to varying client needs.

This role is part of our passive recruitment efforts, and while an immediate opening may not be available, we welcome experienced and motivated candidates to express their interest. We look forward to connecting with you should a suitable opportunity arise.

Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

• A minimum of three years’ professional Tekla Structures experience

• A good understanding of construction drawings, dimensions, levels and structural geometry

• Strong spatial awareness and attention to detail

• Good written and spoken English

• The ability to understand written instructions, drawing mark-ups and verbal project briefings

• Good time-management and organisational skills

• Availability during agreed Australian business hours

• A reliable and accountable approach to your work



Highly regarded experience

The following would be an advantage but is not essential:

• Scaffold drafting or scaffold design

• ScaffPlan

• Temporary works or construction access systems

• Point clouds or laser-scanning data

• Australian construction or engineering projects

• IFC and CAD-reference coordination

What you’ll receive

• Structured onboarding and technical guidance

• Training in ScaffPlan and scaffold-design workflows

• Exposure to varied international construction projects

• The opportunity to develop specialist scaffold and temporary-works knowledge

• Long-term professional development and increased project responsibility



How to apply

Use referral code: JOSP260717

title: Customer Suport Manager
description:
E-commerce Customer Support Manager

We are looking for an experienced E-commerce Customer Support Manager to take full ownership of the customer support operations for multiple international e-commerce stores. 



This is not a basic customer service agent position. We are specifically looking for someone who has previously managed customer support teams and has built structured customer support systems for other e-commerce businesses.



Experience with fashion e-commerce or fashion dropshipping stores is strongly preferred.



You will be responsible for managing the support team, improving workflows, documenting processes, maintaining SOPs, creating Loom training videos, monitoring customer service performance and ensuring that customer issues are handled correctly and efficiently.



The goal is for you to independently manage the complete customer support department without constant supervision.



Position Details



* Full-time position

* Long-term opportunity

* Salary is negotiable based on your experience, responsibilities and expected workload

* Salary will be paid twice per month through Wise

* Opportunity for salary growth when the stores, team and responsibilities grow



Main Responsibilities



Customer Support Management



* Take full ownership of the customer support department

* Manage, train and monitor customer support agents

* Review the quality of customer conversations and provide feedback

* Make sure customer inquiries are handled correctly and on time

* Help the team with complex customer cases

* Ensure that agents follow the correct procedures and company policies

* Organize the daily workload between tea
mbers

* Identify recurring mistakes and create systems to prevent them



Workflows and SOPs



* Create, improve and maintain customer support SOPs

* Build clear workflows for recurring customer situations

* Create Loom training videos for agents

* Build onboarding and training materials for new tea
mbers

* Create templates, canned responses and internal checklists

* Make sure all customer support documentation stays updated

* Improve communication between customer support, suppliers and management



Performance and Reporting



* Monitor customer response times and resolution times

* Track refund rates, chargeback rates and customer satisfaction

* Prepare clear weekly reports about customer support performance

* Identify the main reasons customers contact us

* Identify problems that cause unnecessary refunds or chargebacks

* Suggest and implement improvements

* Hold tea
mbers accountable for their performance

* Make sure important cases are followed up until they are completely resolved



Operational Responsibilities



* Work with our customer support software and Shopify stores

* Communicate with suppliers about order-related problems

* Monitor unresolved and unfulfilled orders

* Make sure refunds, replacements and exchanges are processed correctly

* Escalate serious issues to the owner when necessary

* Help improve the overall customer experience across all stores



Required Experience



You must have previous experience with:



* Managing a customer support team

* Working for one or more e-commerce companies

* Creating customer support workflows

* Writing and maintaining SOPs

* Creating Loom training videos

* Training and onboarding customer support agents

* Handling refunds, returns, exchanges and delivery problems

* Managing difficult customer situations

* Working with Shopify

* Reporting customer support KPIs

* Working independently and taking ownership



You should also have:



* good written and spoken English

* Strong leadership and communication skills

* Good attention to detail

* A structured and process-driven working style

* The ability to identify problems and create practical solutions

* The confidence to give feedback and hold tea
mbers accountable

* A reliable computer and stable internet connection

* Availability for a full-time, long-term position



Strongly Preferred



The following experience is strongly preferred:



* Fashion e-commerce

* Fashion dropshipping stores

* Managing support for multiple Shopify stores

* Working with international customers

* Chargeback prevention

* Refund-rate reduction

* Supplier communication

* Creating complete customer service playbooks

* Experience with customer support platforms such as Gorgias, Richpanel, Re:amaze, Zendesk, Commslayer or similar software



Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is proactive and does not wait for every instruction.



You should be able to look at the current customer support operation, identify what is missing and improve it.



You should be comfortable saying:



* This workflow is unclear and needs to be improved

* This agent needs additional training

* This issue keeps happening and needs a permanent solution

* This SOP is outdated and should be updated

* This KPI is getting worse and we need to take action



We do not want someone who only answers customer
s. We want someone who can build, manage and continuously improve the complete customer support operation.



How to Apply



Start your application with the words:



**SUPPORT MANAGER**



Applications that do not start with these words will not be considered.



Please answer the following questions:



1. How many years of e-commerce customer support experience do you have?



2. How many customer support agents have you previously managed?



3. Which e-commerce companies or stores have you worked for?



4. Have you worked for fashion e-commerce or fashion dropshipping stores? Please explain.



5. Have you created complete customer support SOPs and workflows before? Give specific examples.



6. Which Loom training videos or onboarding materials have you created?



7. Which customer support KPIs did you monitor in your previous role?



8. How did you help reduce refunds, chargebacks or customer complaints?



9. Which Shopify and customer support tools have you used?



10. Describe a recurring customer support problem that you identified and permanently solved.



11. What would your first 30 days look like if you joined our company?



12. What is your expected monthly salary in USD for a full-time position?



Please also include:



* Your CV or résumé

* Links or examples of SOPs, workflows, dashboards or training materials you have created

* A short video introduction 

* Your internet speed test

* Your earliest available starting date



Please do not apply if you only have experience as a customer service agent and have never managed agents, workflows, SOPs or a customer support department.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.



Job description

We're looking for a Marketing Specialist to shape how our health & pharmaceutical brands communicate across both digital & offline channels. You'll craft effective strategies that translate scientific credibility into compelling storytelling & creative assets - helping us engage our diverse audience as we expand our presence regionally. 



The Marketing Specialist will be the visionary link between our brand identity, compelling content creation & drive measurable performance across all key channels. This role is responsible for developing & testing high-impact creative strategies as well as producing content assets (visual, video, copy) internally, specifically designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates, lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee & Lazada stores via social media as well as paid advertising platforms.



You'll work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the new channels of the business. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy

- Platform & Channel Strategy: Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific best practices & formats that align with brand goals & regulatory requirements in each market (e.g., Meta carousel ads, vertical video for TikTok/Reels, static product carousels for Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banner ads).

- Hypothesis Generation & A/B Testing: Develop robust creative testing matrices, formulate clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, calls-to-action, visual styles, copy length) that drive measurable improvements in Click-Through Rate (CTR) & Conversion Rate (CVR).

- Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion).

- Competitive Analysis: Continuously keep up to date with competitors & industry trends, identifying new & successful creative formats, hooks & messaging to finetune our strategy.

In-House Content Production & Execution 

- Performance Creative Development: Lead the end-to-end creative concept development & production for all organic & paid media campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, etc.) that align with brand & campaign goals, focusing on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing required for performance marketing.

- Hands-on Asset Creation: Directly produce & edit native social content & performance ads using existing assets, stock libraries & internal resources. This includes:

i. Plan platform-specific content calendars: Cover educational, promotional & corporate communications

ii. Static/Image Editing: Adapt product photography, create ad variations & design simple graphics & banner ads

iii. Video Editing: Fast-paced assembly, cutting, adding text overlays, music & effects for short-form, vertical video (UGC-style, product demos, testimonials)

- Copywriting: Develop high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social media captions that align with the creative strategy & brand voice, with a focus on clear value propositions & strong CTAs.

- Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across relevant channels (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada store fronts & advertising platforms).

- Testing & Optimization: apply insights & analytics to refine & optimize content effectiveness across platforms.

Performance & Reporting

- Data-Driven Insights: Work closely with the Marketing Manager to analyze creative performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving results (or failing) across Shopify, Shopee & Lazada traffic.

- Iteration & Optimization: 

i. Develop, adapt or review content & formats to improve engagement & performance

ii. Use performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR) to rapidly iterate on existing creative assets & inform future strategy, ensuring a continuous cycle of improvement & optimization

Storefront Integration: Integrate winning creative messages & visuals onto the respective e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey.

Multi-Channel Storytelling

- Content cohesion: Ensure content is aligned where possible across digital & print media, including LinkedIn, Instagram,
, YouTube, e-commerce platforms, brochures & trade materials.

- Tailor content: To achieve relevance & effectiveness across different stages of the audience journey — from brand awareness & education to conversion.

- Storytelling & visual consistency: To strengthen brand trust & recognition.

Compliance & Brand Integrity

- Uphold regulatory & ethical communication standards across all marketing activities.

- Ensure all content complies with regulatory guidelines & marketing requirements in each country we operate in, including product claims, advertising language & digital promotions.

- Maintain brand credibility by ensuring all communications are factual & aligned with company values.

- Collaborate with internal teams to review materials for accuracy, effectiveness & compliance before publication.



Requirements:

- 3–5 years of experience in creative strategy, content creation, social media, or brand marketing — ideally in health supplements, healthcare or wellness.

- Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta (FB/IG), LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Google, Generative AI).

- Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools.

- Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills — adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals.

- Excellent communication, project management & cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Supabase / Postgres) — Remote
description:
We're a growing consumer subscription business — not a tech company ourselves, we just rely heavily on a modern tech stack to run day-to-day operations. We're looking for a senior engineer to take ownership of our backend systems long-term.

What You'll Own





Database & backend: Postgres/Supabase schema, row-level security (RLS) policies, functions, triggers, and migrations across connected codebases

Three connected apps: a React Native/Expo mobile app, a React/Vite staff platform, and a React/Vite PWA used on-site — you don't need to be an expert in all three, but need to understand how they share the same backend

Automations & integrations: n8n workflows, third-party data ingestion (webhooks/APIs), payment/CRM integrations

Deployment & infrastructure: Vercel, Railway, GitHub Actions/CI

Documentation & process: making the system understandable and maintainable by more than one person, not reliant on one person's memory





Must-Have Experience





5+ years professional backend/full-stack development

Strong, hands-on Postgres experience — comfortable with functions, triggers, indexes, and query performance, not just basic queries

Direct experience with Supabase specifically, including row-level security (RLS) policy design — this is the single most important skill for this role

Solid React experience (React Native/Expo a plus, not required)

Comfortable working independently in a remote, async-first environment

Strong written English communication — you'll be documenting decisions for both technical and non-technical stakeholders





Strongly Preferred





Experience auditing or improving security on an existing system, not just building new features

Experience owning a system solo or as a lead, not just contributing to one

Familiarity with n8n or similar workflow automation tools

Experience with consumer subscription or membership-based platforms

title: Operations  Quality Manager — Digital Management Agency (Remote)
description:
We are a fast-growing digital management agency scaling rapidly in both revenue and roster size. The single biggest lever on our revenue is operational consistency — making sure every creator on our platform is supported by workflows, quality standards, and systems that perform reliably every single week, regardless of who is working. This role owns that standard.



WHAT WE OFFER

— $1,000 to $1,300 per month base, depending on experience

 — Discretionary monthly performance bonus tied to operational KPIs, quality targets, SLA adherence, SOP adoption, and leadership performance

 — Fully remote, full-time (8 hours per day, 5 days per week)

 — Reports directly to the Chief Revenue Officer

 — 2 direct reports at hire, with scope to build and lead a growing quality function as the roster scales

 — A systems-ownership role with real operational impact at scale

 — Target start date: August 2026



THE ROLE

* This role does not sell, and it does not reinvent the playbook. It makes sure the playbook is executed consistently, reviewed rigorously, and improved continuously.

* As Operations Quality Manager you will own the operational quality of our creator portfolio. You will make sure every workflow behind the Chat team is followed correctly, every output meets a defined standard, and quality never drifts as the operation scales. You will manage a Content VA and Audience Engagement VA at hire, with responsibility to build and lead the quality function as the department grows.

* Success here is defined by how consistently the operation performs — not by how much work you personally do.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

* Operational quality end to end — own QA across core workflows covering content planning, PPV and customs preparation, welcome bundles, profile optimisation, audience engagement, and cross-team issue resolution, with a quality check built into every handoff before it reaches the Chat team

* The weekly quality cadence — lead a data-driven weekly review of every creator's core quality and compliance metrics, translate gaps into specific corrective actions, and hold the team accountable against a visible quality scorecard

* Quality governance and standards enforcement — QA every workflow output against a defined quality and brand standard before it reaches the Chat team, with a strong audience-experience lens so content is packaged to convert — nothing ships below bar

SOP adoption and documentation — keep every process documented, adopted, and current, using AI tooling to build, audit, and refresh workflows so adherence stays high as the operation evolves

* Team coaching and cross-functional coordination — coach and develop the operations team toward consistent execution standards, partner with Chat and Client Success to resolve creator concerns within SLA, protecting retention and reducing churn

* Prioritisation and corrective action — review account performance weekly, identify recurring issues and lagging accounts, prioritise QA resources based on revenue opportunity and quality risk, and track improvement plans through completion



NON-NEGOTIABLES

— Adherence discipline: the SOP is the standard — no undocumented workarounds and no skipped quality checks under pressure

 — Data over opinion: every judgment on quality, content, and priorities is anchored to performance data, reviewed weekly

 — Standards leadership: holds the line on quality and process even under pressure to cut corners for short-term output



WHAT YOU WILL BE MEASURED ON

— Weekly deliverables consistently shipped on time and meeting defined QA standards

 — Operational concerns resolved within agreed SLAs, each with a durable fix logged

 — Quality trends improving consistently across the portfolio, with recurring issues traced to root cause and lagging accounts closed rather than ignored

 — Chat team consistently receiving complete, production-ready content and assets

 — SOP adherence staying high, enabling rapid onboarding and reducing dependence on any single individual

 — Rework and recurring errors declining quarter over quarter

 — Tea
mbers coached to consistent, independent, on-standard execution

Targets and weightings set quarterly with the Chief Revenue Officer.



WHAT YOU BRING

Experience (non-negotiable)

 — 3+ years in operations, quality assurance, or operations leadership within a remote, fast-paced business — agency, SaaS, startup, eCommerce, BPO, customer operations, or creator business

 — Demonstrated ownership of documented workflows, SOPs, quality standards, and measurable process improvement

 — Experience managing a remote team or direct reports

 — Creator economy or subscription platform experience preferred but not required

Skills (must-have)

 — Workflow platforms — Process Street, ClickUp, Asana, or similar

 — AI tools — Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent — used to build and maintain processes

 — Strong spreadsheet and data literacy, comfortable turning numbers into action

 — Comfortable analysing operational dashboards, identifying recurring quality issues, and translating data into clear corrective actions

 — SOP writing, quality documentation, and project management

 — Sound diagnostic judgment — able to distinguish a process failure from a people-performance issue, and a coaching opportunity from a systemic problem, and respond proportionally

 — Clear written and verbal English

 — Sound visual and creative judgment — able to raise the quality of profiles, welcome bundles, and content with a strong audience-experience lens, while keeping execution consistent and on-standard



Who you are (non-negotiable)

 — Highly accountable, structured, and detail-oriented

 — Calm under pressure, coachable, and curious

 — A natural standards-keeper who leads through influence and accountability

 — Comfortable with change and building in a fast-moving environment



LOGISTICS

Location: Remote. Philippines preferred.

Hours: Full-time, 8 hours per day, 5 days per week. 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM PHT, with a minimum of 4 hours overlap with Revenue Leadership and Chat Operations.

Language: Clear written and verbal English required.

description:
You'll be executing a focused 60-day SEO engagement for a U.S.-based B2B biotech client in the bioavailability and ingredient science space. The goal is measurable ranking improvement -- real movement on real keywords.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:



- Run a fresh SEMrush site audit and confirm keyword targets

- Conduct competitor keyword analysis to identify ranking gaps

- Optimize existing website pages around confirmed target keywords — meta titles, descriptions, H1/H2 structure, body copy, and internal linking

- Rewrite and refine existing page content to naturally incorporate target keywords without sacrificing readability

- Build strategic internal linking — correct anchor text, link equity distribution, crawl depth improvement

- Implement all on-page changes directly inside WordPress using Yoast SEO

- Submit URLs for indexing via Google Search Console as optimized pages go live

- Monitor GSC for indexing status, impressions, clicks, and ranking signals weekly

- Submit a weekly activity log (date, task, time spent, platform used) every Friday



WHAT WE'RE TRACKING AT DAY 60:



Keywords in Top 20 / Top 10

Keywords ranking total (target: 40+)

Pages with organic presence (target: 10+)

Non-branded impressions/mo (target: 200+)

Site Health Score (target: 95%+)



REQUIREMENTS:



2+ years of hands-on SEO execution — actual on-page work, not agency reporting

SEMrush — site audit, position tracking, keyword research, competitor gap analysis

Google Search Console — ranking data, indexing issues, URL submission

WordPress — confident editing pages and content without breaking things

Yoast SEO — meta titles, descriptions, content scoring

Internal linking strategy — anchor text, link equity, crawl depth

Content writing/editing — ability to rewrite copy for a B2B science audience

Strong written English for weekly client-facing reports



HOW WE VERIFY WORK

Weekly time logs are required for payment release. If you're not comfortable with that level of accountability, this isn't the right fit.



HOW TO APPLY

Send all four of the following — incomplete applications will not be reviewed:



1. A past SEO engagement summary: what the site was, what you did, and what moved — specific numbers only

2. Screenshot or export of a SEMrush audit or position tracking report you personally produced

3. Your available hours per week and timezone

4. In 2-3 sentences: what does bioavailability mean and why does it matter to a B2B ingredient supplier?

- You communicate professionally and naturally in English

- You are comfortable receiving direct feedback

- You genuinely want to learn and improve

- You have a quiet, professional workspace

- You have reliable internet and a backup solution

- You are looking for a stable, long-term position with one company



Previous experience in customer support, sales, GoHighLevel or another CRM is helpful, but it is not required. Strong potential, preparation, judgment and grit matter more to us than having the longest resume.



This Role Is Not a Good Fit If



- You want to combine this position with another full-time job

- You prefer rushing through messages instead of understanding customers

- You rely on AI without checking its work

- You dislike feedback, targets or performance reviews

- You cannot consistently work the required schedule

- You are mainly looking for a temporary position



Compensation and Development



- Starting salary of $800 to $1,000+ USD per month

- The exact offer depends on your application, communication and performance during the paid trial

- Paid training

- Performance and salary review after the first 90 days

- Opportunity to grow in responsibility and compensation based on performance



What Success Looks Like



- Customers receive timely and thoughtful responses

- High-intent leads receive fast follow-up

- Conversations move toward a clear next step

- Customer information in GoHighLevel remains accurate

- Messages are clear, professional and free from avoidable mistakes

- Feedback results in visible improvement

- Customers feel that someone genuinely understands and wants to help them



How to Apply



Apply directly through OnlineJobs.



Please use exactly 8 Apply Points. There is no advantage to using more than 8. We evaluate the quality of your application and video, not how many additional points you spend.



Use this subject line:



T2R Customer Support - [Your First Name]



Your application must include:



1. A Personal Video



Send a video recorded specifically for Today2Repair.



A video of approximately 3 to 6 minutes will usually be enough, but we care more about the quality of your answers than the exact length.



Record the video from the workspace you would actually use for this job. Professional editing is not required. Clear audio, good lighting, preparation and a quiet environment are important.



Notes are fine, but please speak naturally instead of reading a fully generated script.



Answer these questions:



- Who are you, and what are you currently doing?

- Why are you interested in this specific position at Today2Repair?

- What is one specific thing you noticed after looking

- That you can work Monday through Saturday from 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM Philippine time

- Whether you currently have another job or client

Important



We use AI in our work, but we want to understand your own personality, communication and judgment.

title: Video Editor
description:
Video Editor — Peakfinity Labs



**Employment Type:** [Full-Time / Part-Time / Contract]

**Department:** Marketing & Content



## About Peakfinity Labs



Peakfinity Labs is a manufacturing company focused on supplements and cosmetics. We're looking for a talented Video Editor to help us tell our story — from the factory floor to the finished product — through compelling, high-quality video content.



## About the Role



We're hiring a Video Editor to create engaging video content that showcases our manufacturing processes, products, and company culture. You'll work with raw footage from our facilities and turn it into polished videos for marketing, training, social media, and internal communications.



## What You'll Do



- Edit raw footage into polished, engaging videos for marketing, social media, and internal use

- Cut manufacturing/process footage into clear, compelling narratives

- Add motion graphics, text overlays, color correction, and sound design as needed

- Collaborate with the marketing team on video concepts and messaging

- Manage multiple projects and turnaround deadlines

- Organize and maintain video assets and project files



## What We're Looking For



- Proven experience editing video content (portfolio required — see below)

- Proficiency in editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro

- Strong storytelling instincts — ability to turn raw, unscripted footage into a clear narrative

- Understanding of pacing, color grading, sound design, and motion graphics

- Comfortable working with industrial/manufacturing footage (a plus, not required)

- Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines



## How to Apply



To apply, please send us:



1. **Your portfolio** — a link or reel showcasing your best editing work.

2. **(Optional, but recommended) A sample edit** — To help us prioritize applications, we invite you to download raw footage from **
** and produce a short edited video (60–90 seconds) that tells a clear, engaging story using the clips provided. We want to see how you structure a narrative, pace cuts, and polish raw material — not just your software skills.



   *Tips for a strong sample edit:*

   - Choose a clear focus or theme rather than using every clip

   - Aim for a logical flow: an opening hook, a clear middle, and a satisfying close

   - Include basic color correction, clean audio, and simple titles/graphics if relevant

   - Keep it tight — quality of storytelling matters more than length



Applicants who submit a sample edit alongside their portfolio will be prioritized for review.

---



Peakfinity Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Our workload rises and falls. When volume is high, we need everyone measuring. When it slows, some tea
mbers are placed on standby — a temporary pause, not a termination. You stay part of our team and are first in line to be called back when the next surge hits (we expect these regularly).

Schedule



Availability required Thursday through Monday, U.S. hours. Tuesday and Wednesday are your days off.

40 hours per week, with scheduled breaks included in those 40 hours.

Your main job is outlining homes on Google Earth with our measuring software to calculate each roof's square footage. This work is highly repetitive — you'll run the same process all day and need to hold both speed and accuracy. Tea
mbers may measure 2,000+ homes per week.

Fast, reliable internet connection

Strong spoken and written English (we hold weekly tea
etings)

mbers doing this work — many for 7–14 months — and they've been very happy here.

Taylor

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
Scope of Work

We are a U.S. Healthcare-based company seeking an expert in Philippine labour law and human resources to produce a comprehensive guide/checklist covering the following:

-How to determine whether a worker in the Philippines should be engaged as a contractor (independent contractor) vs. an employee, under Philippine law.

-A checklist for engaging someone in the Philippines as a contractor: what must be done to comply (from U.S. company perspective + Philippine perspective).

-What documents need to be collected and retained for on?boarding a contractor in the Philippines (e.g., ID, passport, tax registration, local business registration if applicable, contract for services, etc.).

-How to establish a Philippine entity (or outsource structure) so our U.S. company can hire or engage Philippines?based contractor(s) legally, including the steps, registration requirements, fees, entity types (branch vs subsidiary vs local contractor), and compliance obligations (tax/social security/benefits).

-Useful practical matters: hours/day, hours/week, benefits (what one must provide or not provide if truly a contractor), pay schedule (suggested best practice), and risk mitigation (what to avoid to prevent mis?classification and employer liability).

-Written guide in checklist/table format, with explanatory text, and with all major legal references (Philippine statutes/regulations/DOLE pronouncements) cited in footnotes or end?notes.

-Maintaining HIPAA compliance

BOTTOM LINE: How to on-board a contractor while maintaining compliance under Philippine law and HIPAA compliance



Deliverables

A Word or PDF document with:

Section A: Contractor vs Employee – classification overview, key criteria, legal references.

Section B: Checklist for engaging a contractor in the Philippines (step?by?step).

Section C: Documents on?boarding checklist (for contractor individual and for your U.S. company).

Section D: How to form a Philippine entity / legal vehicle, steps, entity types, compliance obligations.

Section E: Practical terms: hours/day, hours/week, pay schedule, benefits (what to provide vs what to avoid for independent contractor), POA/contract drafting tips, monitoring/control risks.

Section F: Reference appendix – list of laws/regulations with citations (government site links where available).



Budget & Timeline

Pay: USD$7 per hour, up to maximum 10 hours total (i.e., USD$70 maximum).

Timeline: Complete draft within 2 business days after contract.

Payment terms: Upon delivery of final document and acceptance.



Required Expertise

-Proven experience in Philippine labour law (especially classification of contractors vs employees) and HR compliance.

-Ability to reference Philippine laws/regulations (e.g., Labour Code, DOLE Department Orders, relevant jurisprudence).

-Experience advising foreign (U.S.) companies hiring in the Philippines is a plus.

-Good English and ability to provide a clear, structured checklist format.

title: Client Response and Outreach Coordinator - Australian Day Shift, 7:00am to 10:00am Manila, Monday to Friday
description:
$8.75 USD per hour. 15 hours per week guaranteed, up to 20 as required.



About us



Ready2Exit is Australia's leading SMB M&A advisory firm. We help business owners sell the companies they have spent twenty or thirty years building, and we help buyers acquire them properly. Most of the people we deal with are owner operators in trades, manufacturing and services, and for almost all of them, selling their business is the largest financial decision they will ever make.



I am Stuart Earl, Investor, M&A Advisor and leader of Australia's largest business marketplace with over 180,000 members. 



We are a lean team which means this role carries more weight than the same title would carry somewhere larger. You will work directly with me every day. What you do will show up directly in whether this business grows, and you will be able to watch that happen rather than take my word for it.



What we care about

Most business owners only sell a business once in their life. The industry does not serve them well, and the complaints are always the same: overpromising, no transparency, and no real buyer engagement. We built Ready2Exit to fix that, through preparation, honesty and doing the work properly.



Three things matter here more than anything else, and they will shape your day.



The first is speed. When a business owner calls us back, they are d
 in that 
nt whether we are serious people. A response forty five minutes later answers that question for them, and not in our favour.

The second is precision. Details are not administration in this business. A wrong figure in a follow up
 can cost us a mandate that took months to win.

The third is honesty, and that includes honesty upwards. If I have made a mistake, I would rather hear it from you on the day than find it myself a fortnight later. The same applies in the other direction, and I will tell you directly when something is not right. Most people prefer working that way once they get used to it.



The role

You will own the front line of our communication, in both directions.



On one side, we run outreach campaigns and paid advertising that generate inbound calls, replies and form submissions. Those currently sit too long before anyone answers them, and it is the single biggest gap in our week. Closing that gap is the main reason this role exists.



On the other side, when we take on a business to sell, we build a list of buyers who might be a fit and we call them. That outbound work is yours as well. It is not cold selling. It is ringing people who are actively looking to buy a business and telling them we have something worth a conversation.



Either way, you are the first person from Ready2Exit that a buyer or a business owner ever speaks to. That is not an administrative job, and I do not intend to treat it as one.



What you will be responsible for



The list below is in priority order, and the order genuinely matters. When two things compete, the one higher up wins. You will never need to ask my permission to drop something for an inbound call.



Inbound response. Every call, reply and form submission that comes from our campaigns. Qualify it against criteria I will give you, then book it, route it or close it out. Log every single one. You own that contact from the first touch through to a booked appointment.



Outbound buyer outreach. When we have a business on the market, you will work through a buyer list by phone and
, introduce the opportunity, and book the ones who are interested.



Callbacks and appointment booking. Returning missed calls and managing my diary around them.



Follow up. Post pitch follow up by
 and phone, on a cadence that you own and run without me reminding you, plus a weekly sweep of the pipeline for anything that has gone quiet.



Scheduling and rescheduling. Multi party, across time zones, with nothing dropped.



Administration. Onboarding
s and forms, and setting up document folders and permissions for live deals.



The standard



We are a high performance team and we thrive on overdelivering for our clients.



Fifteen minutes is the response time inside your window. We will measure it, and it will be your key measure of success.

Some mornings a campaign goes out and inbound will take your entire window. Other mornings it will be quiet and you will work through the background list. Both of those are normal and neither is a problem.



Outside your window we are honestly uncovered. Automation acknowledges people and you call them at the start of the next morning. We do not pretend to be larger than we are.



Who I am looking for



You have worked somewhere the phone was the revenue. That might be a medical or dental front desk, service dispatch, roadside assistance, insurance claims intake, hotel reservations, client services at a broking firm, or an inbound queue with a target on the wall. What matters is that you have done this under a clock rather than at your own pace.



You will know the specific feeling of being halfway through careful work when something urgent lands. You can deal with the urgent thing, log it properly before you move on, and then go back and finish the careful work without breaking it. Most people manage two of those three. If you can do all three reliably, you are the person I want to talk to.



Your English needs to be strong in both directions. You will be speaking with Australian owner operators in trades, manufacturing and services, and they will hang up if following you takes effort. You will also be writing
s that go out under my name into live deals, so your written English needs to be good enough that I can send it as it is.



You should get a kick out of a fast moving environment where things change without much warning. Some mornings the plan lasts ten minutes before a campaign lands or a deal moves. If that reads as chaos to you, this will not suit. If it reads as a good morning, we should talk. The people who do well here are the ones who are comfortable in the unknown and would rather work something out than wait to be told.



Beyond that, I am looking for someone who is genuinely detail obsessed, to the point of finding the error nobody told you was there. Someone who can be given an outcome rather than a method and work out the rest without needing to be walked through it. Someone who does not need me standing behind them. And someone with mature confidence, by which I mean you will tell me when you think I am wrong, once, with your reasoning, and then get on with the decision either way.

What you get



The rate is $8.75 USD per hour, with 15 hours guaranteed and up to 20 hours in weeks where the volume requires it, at the same rate. You are also paid 13th month.



On growth, I will be straight with you rather than make a promise I cannot stand behind. Our volume is increasing and my intention is to take this role to 30 hours or more within three months. That will happen when the workload supports it and when you have shown you can hold the standard, not on a fixed date I invent now to make this advertisement more attractive. If both of those things are true, the hours are there and the path to full time is real.



You will work directly with me, with no layers in between. You will get proper training, and you will learn how business acquisitions actually work, which is exposure that very few people in this market ever get. You will also be trusted with confidential financial information and live deals from early on, because there is no version of this job where you are kept at arm's length from the real work.



Nice to have, though not required

Experience with GoHighLevel, SharePoint or OneDrive, exposure to Australian clients, or a background in professional services or finance.



How to apply

Please read this section properly. A large number of applications will be set aside for missing a step, and that is deliberate.

1. Begin your application with the word DISPATCH.

2. Then answer these three questions, briefly:



- What was your response time target in your last role, and what happened when you missed it?

- Tell me about the last time something urgent interrupted you mid task. What happened to the work you were in the middle of?

- What is your internet speed, and what do you do when it drops out?



3. Record a video of one to two minutes and include the link. An unlisted YouTube video, a Loom or a Google Drive link are all fine. Speak to camera and tell me why this role interests you, why you are the right fit for it, and what makes you the standout candidate.



Please do not script it. I want to hear you think. A polished read tells me nothing about how you will sound on a live call with an Australian business owner, and that is the part of the job I actually need to assess.



Attach your CV.



Stuart Earl

M&A Advisor | Founder, Ready2Exit

Australia's leading SMB M&A Advisory Firm

title: Creator Research and Outreach Virtual Assistant
description:
Voyage is a growth agency that builds digital products for creators. We partner with creators to turn their expertise into mobile and subscription apps that their audience can buy and use, for example a fitness app built around a trainer's programs and coaching. We are looking for a reliable, self-directed virtual assistant to build our creator prospect lists and prepare outreach for these partnerships.



You will not be sending messages or joining calls. Your role covers everything that leads up to that: finding creators who fit our criteria, qualifying them properly, and drafting personalised outreach that reads naturally. We handle the outreach from there.



Because we build products out of a creator's knowledge, the creators we target must have real, teachable expertise. Think coaches, instructors, and educators who genuinely teach their audience something, not accounts that are mainly about looks or lifestyle.



This role will suit someone who is comfortable researching across Instagram and TikTok, has a good eye for quality, and can write clear, natural English.



## What you will do



* Build prospect lists from a defined brief, covering platform, engagement quality, content type, and audience fit

* Qualify each creator properly rather than relying on numbers alone. This means watching their content, checking whether they present well to camera, and assessing whether they have a genuine connection with their audience

* Record the key details in a lead tracker (we will set this up with you)

* Identify the best way to contact each creator and note it

* Draft a short, personalised outreach
 for each qualified creator, referencing something specific about them rather than generic praise

* Keep the pipeline organised and hand over clean, ready-to-use leads and drafts



As a guide, we expect around 7 to 10 qualified creators per day, allowing roughly 15 to 20 minutes to qualify each one properly. Quality of fit matters more than volume.



## Who you are



* Excellent written English. This is essential, as your drafts need to read naturally and professionally

* Confident and efficient navigating Instagram and TikTok, with a good sense of what makes a creator's audience engaged

* Strong research skills. You verify information and do not simply rely on the first result you find

* Organised and accurate. The lead tracker stays clean and correct

* Self-directed. Once you understand the brief, you can work independently without close supervision



## Nice to have



* Experience with influencer or creator research tools (Social Blade, Modash, HypeAuditor, or similar)

* A background in social media, marketing, or partnerships

* Familiarity with Airtable, Notion, or Google Sheets for tracking





## The details



Fully remote

Part-time to start, around 20 hours per week, with the opportunity to grow into a larger role

A few hours of daily overlap with New Zealand business hours (NZST)

Rate: USD $5 to $7 per hour, depending on experience

Paid trial before we commit, so both sides can confirm the fit



## How to apply



Please submit your application through our application form: 



Complete both steps below. We only consider applications that include both, submitted via the form above.



1. Record a 60-second video. Introduce yourself, outline your relevant experience, and explain why you are a good fit for this role. It does not need to be polished. We simply want to see how you communicate.



2. Complete a short screening task. Using the brief below, find two creators who fit and draft the outreach
 you would send to one of them.



Context for the task: Voyage builds mobile apps for creators, turning their expertise into a product their audience can buy and use. So we are looking for creators with genuine, teachable skill, whose knowledge could become an app such as a training program, coaching, or structured course.



## Brief for the task:



Platform: Instagram or TikTok

Niche: women's fitness or wellness

Followers: 100k to 250k

Audience: mostly women aged 30 to 45

Must have: educational or instructional content that shows real expertise. For example, a coach breaking down technique, a trainer sharing programs, or an instructor teaching a method

Not a fit: accounts that are mainly modelling, aesthetics, or lifestyle, with no teachable skill behind them



For each creator, provide their handle, their approximate follower count, one line on why their audience looks engaged, and one line on what expertise of theirs could become an app. Then write the outreach
 for one of them, introducing the idea of us building an app around their expertise.



We are not expecting perfection. We want to understand how you think and whether you can follow a brief.

title: Bookeeper |Finance Administrator
description:
ROLE TITLE: Bookkeeper / Finance Administrator (Offshore, Part-Time)



Hours: Approx. 2 hours/day, 5 days/week (~10 hours/week) extending to more hours.

Reports to: GM — Sonya Keenan

Entity: Changing Habits (Divitiae Health Pty Ltd t/a Changing Habits)

Location: Remote / Offshore (via agency)

Start Date: Target: end of July / start of August 2026



ABOUT THE ROLE

Changing Habits is a fast-moving ecommerce brand on Shopify with ~1,100+ orders per month. We operate

across three core platforms — Shopify, CIN7, and Xero — and need a dedicated bookkeeper who can keep our

numbers clean, current, and trustworthy on a daily basis.

This is not a monthly catch-up role. We run the business day to day and we need someone who does the same

with our financials. If something doesn't reconcile, we need to know within the day — not at the end of the

month.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Daily reconciliation of bank accounts, Shopify settlements, and PayPal/gateway deposits in Xero

• Match and clear supplier invoices against purchase orders in CIN7 and Xero

• Flag anomalies, missing settlements, or overdue payables immediately — not at end of month

• Keep Xero accounts payable current and accurate (accrual basis, not cash)

• Cross-check incoming invoices against expected amounts and raise queries where figures don't align

• Support transition to accrual-based COGS reporting so gross profit reflects actual stock sold, not invoices

paid

• Assist with preparation of data and reports to support BAS lodgement

• General financial and admin including forms, follow-ups, and document management as directed



WHAT YOU NEED

• Proven bookkeeping experience — you must be confident with debits, credits, bank reconciliations, and

accounts payable is essential

• Xero — strong working knowledge is essential

• Ecommerce experience essential — you must understand how online store settlements, refunds, and order

flows work

• Experience with a stock management / inventory system (CIN7 or equivalent) – preferred however can be

trained

• Comfortable with spreadsheets and basic financial analysis — you'll extract, review, and flag data regularly

• Detail-oriented and proactive — if something doesn't look right, you raise it the same day

Highly Valued

• Shopify — experience reading and reconciling sales data, settlements, and payout reports

• CIN7 — direct experience preferred; we can train the right person on CIN7 specifics

• Experience supporting a small ecommerce team where you own the day-to-day financial picture



WHAT WE'RE NOT LOOKING FOR

This is not an accounting or CFO role. We don't need tax strategy or high-level financial planning. We need

clean books, daily reconciliation, and someone who takes ownership of keeping the numbers right. You won't be

managing payroll however assisting with this.



HOW IT WORKS

• Offshore role placed, flexible hours

• Tasks are routine and structured — you'll have a defined set of daily and weekly responsibilities

• Day-to-day management and task direction sits with Ashur (GM)

• Charity (Finance & Operations Manager) retains oversight of payments and payroll

• Approximately 2 hours/day — timing flexible, ideally afternoons AEST so settlements from the prior day

are available

• Over time, this role may expand to include CIN7 inventory support as a backup to our operations

coordinator



KEY SYSTEMS

Xero Accounting, reconciliation, AP/AR Essential

Shopify Ecommerce sales, settlements, reports Essential

CIN7 Inventory, purchase orders, COGS Valued (trainable)

Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets / MS Sharepoint Essential

Reporting, analysis, data review Essential



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU:

•	Cover letter — why they want to join and what they will specifically bring to the role

•	Resume / CV

•	A short video (2–3 minutes) — talk to us like you are already in the room
